theorems.name: Submission.euclid_hausdorff_dilation_change_of_variables
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → ∀ M : Set (Euclid P), Measure.map (fun x : Euclid P => c • x) (μHE[n].restrict ((fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' M)) = ENNReal.ofReal (c⁻¹ ^ n) • μHE[n].restrict M ∧ (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ z in (fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' M, g (c • z) ∂μHE[n] = ENNReal.ofReal (c⁻¹ ^ n) * ∫⁻ y in M, g y ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ z in (fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' M, g (c • z) ∂μHE[n] = c⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ y in M, g y ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
